# Version 3.119.4
> **Expanded platform support** · Released May 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.4)

> **Supersedes [3.119.3](3.119.3.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands platform coverage and fixes deployment and rendering failures. The stable release rolls up the 3.119.3 preview, including Linux ARM64 and AOT fixes, alongside new Gtk4, Tizen, and Linux Bionic support.

## Breaking Changes

- **Blazor _Imports is no longer a component** — The generated Blazor _Imports type no longer derives from ComponentBase or implements component interfaces. Do not reference it as a component; use application components for rendering behavior.

## Platform

- **New Gtk4, Linux Bionic, and Tizen support** — Adds Gtk4 views, Linux Bionic native assets, and Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3527), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3619](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3619))
- **.NET Framework and legacy target support improved** — Adds net48 validation and C# 13 compatibility for legacy target frameworks. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3631), [#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642))

## Bug Fixes

- **Deployment and graphics failures corrected** — Fixes Linux ARM64 startup, GTK4 Cairo assertions, missing Direct3D 12 handling, and MAUI Android SKGLView rendering after tab changes. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494), [#3562](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3562), [#3633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3633), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Security

- **Native dependencies and protections refreshed** — Includes libpng updates and native binary hardening inherited from the 3.119.3 preview. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3723](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3723), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5

Carries the HarfBuzzSharp updates and native hardening from the 3.119 servicing line.
